title: A receipt line
description:
Read three lines: an item's name, a quantity (a whole number) and a unit price (may have decimals). Print the receipt line: the quantity, ` x `, the item, a colon, and the total with two decimals.

```
Item? tea
Quantity? 3
Price? 2.5
3 x tea: 7.50
```

The prompts are `Item? `, `Quantity? ` and `Price? ` (with a space after the question mark). The item's name can contain spaces.

solution.main.lua:
io.write("Item? ")
local item = io.read()
io.write("Quantity? ")
local quantity = tonumber(io.read())
io.write("Price? ")
local price = tonumber(io.read())
print(quantity .. " x " .. item .. ": " .. string.format("%.2f", quantity * price))

hints: `io.read()` returns the line as text. `tonumber` turns `"3"` into the number 3.
`string.format("%.2f", value)` shows a number with exactly two decimals.

tests.name: many cups
tests.expected: Item? Quantity? Price? 12 x cup of coffee: 22.20
